WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM races 
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
finishers AS (
    SELECT 
        r.positionOrder,
        r.position,
        r.time,
        r.milliseconds
    FROM results r
    JOIN race ON r.raceId = race.raceId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
champion AS (
    SELECT 
        time,
        milliseconds
    FROM finishers
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT 
        time,
        positionOrder
    FROM finishers
    ORDER BY positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
champion_ms AS (
    SELECT milliseconds FROM champion
),
last_driver_total AS (
    -- Parse the incremental time of last driver (format: +M:SS.mmm or +SS.mmm)
    -- and add to champion's milliseconds
    SELECT 
        champion_ms.milliseconds AS champ_ms,
        CASE 
            WHEN last_driver.time LIKE '%:%' THEN
                champion_ms.milliseconds + 
                CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, '+') + 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - INSTR(last_driver.time, '+') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
                CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) AS REAL) * 1000
            ELSE
                champion_ms.milliseconds + 
                CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, '+') + 1) AS REAL) * 1000
        END AS last_ms
    FROM champion_ms, last_driver
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((last_ms - champ_ms) * 100.0 / last_ms, 2) AS percentage_faster
FROM last_driver_total

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM races 
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
    SELECT r.milliseconds AS champ_ms
    FROM results r
    JOIN race ON r.raceId = race.raceId
    WHERE r.position = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT r.milliseconds AS last_incremental_ms
    FROM results r
    JOIN race ON r.raceId = race.raceId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r.positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
calc AS (
    SELECT 
        champion.champ_ms,
        last_driver.last_incremental_ms,
        (champion.champ_ms + last_driver.last_incremental_ms) AS last_total_ms
    FROM champion, last_driver
)
SELECT 
    CAST(last_incremental_ms AS REAL) / CAST(last_total_ms AS REAL) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM calc

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId FROM races 
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
    SELECT r.milliseconds as champ_ms
    FROM results r
    JOIN race ON r.raceId = race.raceId
    WHERE r.position = 1 AND r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
),
last_finisher AS (
    SELECT r.time as gap_time, r.positionOrder
    FROM results r
    JOIN race ON r.raceId = race.raceId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.positionOrder = (
        SELECT MAX(r2.positionOrder)
        FROM results r2
        JOIN race rc ON r2.raceId = rc.raceId
        WHERE r2.time IS NOT NULL
    )
),
gap_ms AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN gap_time LIKE '+%.___' THEN
                CAST(SUBSTR(gap_time, 2, INSTR(gap_time, '.') - 2) AS REAL) * 1000 +
                CAST(SUBSTR(gap_time, INSTR(gap_time, '.') + 1) AS REAL)
            ELSE NULL
        END as gap_milliseconds
    FROM last_finisher
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(gap_ms.gap_milliseconds * 100.0 / (champion.champ_ms + gap_ms.gap_milliseconds), 2) as percentage_faster
FROM champion, gap_ms

WITH race AS (
    SELECT r.raceId
    FROM races r
    JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
    WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
finished AS (
    SELECT 
        res.positionOrder,
        res.time,
        res.driverId
    FROM results res
    JOIN race ON res.raceId = race.raceId
    WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
),
champion AS (
    SELECT time FROM finished WHERE positionOrder = 1
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT time FROM finished WHERE positionOrder = (SELECT MAX(positionOrder) FROM finished)
),
champion_ms AS (
    -- Convert HH:MM:SS.mmm to milliseconds
    SELECT 
        (CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600000 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(time, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(time, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(time, 9) AS INTEGER)) AS ms
    FROM champion
),
last_driver_ms AS (
    -- Incremental time format: +M:SS.mmm or +SS.mmm
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN time LIKE '+%:%' THEN
                (CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2, INSTR(SUBSTR(time, 2), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
                 CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2 + INSTR(SUBSTR(time, 2), ':'), 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
                 CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2 + INSTR(SUBSTR(time, 2), ':') + 3) AS INTEGER))
            ELSE
                (CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2, INSTR(time, '.') - 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
                 CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER))
        END AS incremental_ms
    FROM last_driver
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(l.incremental_ms AS REAL) / (c.ms + l.incremental_ms) * 100, 2) AS percentage_faster
FROM champion_ms c, last_driver_ms l

WITH race AS (
    SELECT r.raceId
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
-- Get all finishers (time is not null)
finishers AS (
    SELECT 
        res.driverId,
        res.positionOrder,
        res.time
    FROM results res
    JOIN race ON res.raceId = race.raceId
    WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
),
-- Champion is position 1
champion AS (
    SELECT time FROM finishers WHERE positionOrder = 1
),
-- Convert champion time HH:MM:SS.mmm to milliseconds
champion_ms AS (
    SELECT 
        (CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600000 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(time, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(time, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(time, 9, 3) AS INTEGER)) AS ms
    FROM champion
),
-- Last finisher
last_driver AS (
    SELECT time FROM finishers ORDER BY positionOrder DESC LIMIT 1
),
-- Convert last driver incremental time to milliseconds
-- format could be +M:SS.mmm or +SS.mmm
last_driver_ms AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN INSTR(SUBSTR(time, 2), ':') > 0 THEN
                CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2, INSTR(SUBSTR(time, 2), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
                CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2 + INSTR(SUBSTR(time, 2), ':'), 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
                CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2 + INSTR(SUBSTR(time, 2), ':') + 3, 3) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                CAST(SUBSTR(time, 2, INSTR(time, '.') - 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
                CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1, 3) AS INTEGER)
        END AS incremental_ms
    FROM last_driver
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(last_driver_ms.incremental_ms AS REAL) / 
          CAST(champion_ms.ms + last_driver_ms.incremental_ms AS REAL) * 100, 2) AS percentage_faster
FROM champion_ms, last_driver_ms

      )
),
calc AS (

        champion.milliseconds AS champ_ms,
        -- Parse incremental time from last finisher: format is '+X.XXX' or '+X:XX.XXX'
        CASE 
            WHEN last_finisher.time LIKE '+%:%' THEN
                -- format +M:SS.mmm
                CAST(SUBSTR(last_finisher.time, 2, INSTR(last_finisher.time, ':') - 2) AS REAL) * 60000 +
                CAST(SUBSTR(last_finisher.time, INSTR(last_finisher.time, ':') + 1) AS REAL) * 1000
            ELSE
                -- format +S.mmm
                CAST(SUBSTR(last_finisher.time, 2) AS REAL) * 1000
        END AS increment_ms
    FROM champion, last_finisher
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(increment_ms / (champ_ms + increment_ms) * 100, 2) AS faster_percentage
FROM calc

WITH consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentage_data AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        consumption_2012,
        consumption_2013,
        ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2013) * 100 AS pct_increase
    FROM consumption_data
)
SELECT
    Segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    pct_increase,
    CASE WHEN pct_increase = MAX(pct_increase) OVER() THEN 'Biggest Increase' 
         WHEN pct_increase = MIN(pct_increase) OVER() THEN 'Lowest Increase' 
         ELSE 'Middle' END AS category
FROM percentage_data
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

     SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS increase,

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    f.`School Name`,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

    f.`School Name`,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    CAST(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate

SELECT 
    (CAST((ld.overall_rating - jb.overall_rating) AS REAL) / ld.overall_rating) * 100 AS percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating 
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
     LIMIT 1) ld,
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating 
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
     LIMIT 1) jb

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSoffered = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City

SELECT 
    s.City,
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS NumberOfSchools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MultipleProvisionTypes
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '8'
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City

SELECT 
    s.City,
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS total_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_provision_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City

ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1

    d.nationality,
    r.name AS first_race
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
AND r.date = (
    SELECT MIN(r2.date)
    FROM results res2
    JOIN races r2 ON res2.raceId = r2.raceId
    WHERE res2.driverId = d.driverId
)
LIMIT 1

WITH segment_customers AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT sc.CustomerID, sc.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM segment_customers sc
    JOIN yearmonth y ON sc.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY sc.CustomerID, sc.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
customers_with_min AS (
    SELECT yc.Segment, yc.CustomerID, yc.total_consumption
    FROM yearly_consumption yc
    JOIN min_consumption mc ON yc.Segment = mc.Segment AND yc.total_consumption = mc.min_cons
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers_with_min
    GROUP BY Segment
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_avg
    FROM segment_avg
)
SELECT
    SME_avg - LAM_avg AS SME_minus_LAM,
    LAM_avg - KAM_avg AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    KAM_avg - SME_avg AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM pivoted

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        SUM(cc.total_consumption) / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_average
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_cons
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        SUM(cc.total_consumption) / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_cons
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
customers_with_min AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        cc.total_consumption,
        mc.min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment mc 
        ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment 
        AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_consumption
),
annual_avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers_with_min
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

min_consumption_per_segment AS (

annual_avg_per_segment AS (

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM (
    SELECT ID, MIN(PLT) AS PLT
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PLT < 100
    GROUP BY ID
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ID, MAX(PLT) AS PLT
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PLT > 400
    GROUP BY ID
) AS abnormal_patients

WITH height_extremes AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name, height
    FROM Player
    WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
       OR height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
),
avg_finishing AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.height,
        AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing_rate
    FROM height_extremes p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height
)
SELECT player_name, avg_finishing_rate
FROM avg_finishing
ORDER BY avg_finishing_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    ((CAST((SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk')) AS REAL)
    - (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')))
    / (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')))
    * 100 AS percentage_higher

SELECT 
    (CAST((AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.overall_rating END) - 
           AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) AS REAL) / 
     AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) * 100 AS percentage_higher
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')

SELECT 
    ((AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.overall_rating END) - 
      AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) / 
      AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) * 100
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')

SELECT 
    (CAST(ariel.overall_rating AS REAL) - CAST(paulin.overall_rating AS REAL)) / CAST(paulin.overall_rating AS REAL) * 100 AS percentage_higher
FROM 
    (SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

WHERE m.label = '+'

WITH oldest_female AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
),
oldest_female_with_salary AS (
    SELECT of.client_id, d.A11 as avg_salary
    FROM oldest_female of
    JOIN district d ON of.district_id = d.district_id
),
min_salary_among_oldest AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_salary) as min_sal
    FROM oldest_female_with_salary
),
target_clients AS (
    SELECT ofs.client_id
    FROM oldest_female_with_salary ofs
    JOIN min_salary_among_oldest ms ON ofs.avg_salary = ms.min_sal
),
max_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(A11) as max_sal FROM district
)
SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT max_sal FROM max_salary) - (SELECT min_sal FROM min_salary_among_oldest) AS gap
FROM disp d
JOIN target_clients tc ON d.client_id = tc.client_id
